facts.fact: ARPCE's 2024 report gives a weighted average mobile internet tariff of 0.70 FCFA per megabyte for 2024 (about 700 FCFA per gigabyte at 1,000 MB), an average per-gigabyte price across all technologies and both operators (MTN, Airtel), not a retail plan; the 4G-specific weighted tariff is 2.15 FCFA per MB.

systems.country_label: 2.15 FCFA per MB in 2024 (ARPCE weighted 4G tariff)

note: Per-MB figure converted to per-GB by unit only (x1000); the document states 0.70 FCFA/Mo, not a per-gigabyte or income-share figure. Document gives no publication date; published date 2025-06-17 is an embedded PDF stamp.
